subject: lg-dy
title: LG.DY.------AF.DY.
description: Diagram in MP(I)-15 — the section on bebop's post-forties reception as either-underground-or-let-it-stay-there and the structural separation between creative-music and black political activism (Malcolm X as exception, Huey Newton attaching himself to rock music as the rule). The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'the progressional continuance of creative music from the affinity insight (1) principle... would come to be perceived as either in the underground, or in the underground "and let it stay there." Because the dynamics of its existence had long since been dismissed.' The crossing diagrams how logical-dynamics structurally meets affinity-dynamics in that dismissal: (C)LG-DY (the concept of logical dynamics) crossed with AF-DY (affinity dynamics — the form's actual affinity working). LG-DY sits on the left with the subject-arrow; PRI-INFO (principle information) rises from the main line to the upper-right, MT-IMP (multi-implications) and DYM-SPI branch from PRI-INFO, and TR (transformation) branches from DYM-SPI. AFI (affinity insight) descends from the main line below the subject, LANG-DY (language dynamics) branches left from AFI, and (C)ATTC (the concept of attachment) hangs from LANG-DY; COS-AGN (cosmic assignment) descends from the main line at the lower-right. AF-DY sits at center-right as partner-axis.
